claims.text: The resort is rooted in the history of the Aspen Institute and was designed by Herbert Bayer.

findings.quote: Rooted in the history of the Aspen Institute and designed by Herbert Bayer

claims.text: The grounds cover 40 acres of rolling meadows and groves.

findings.quote: As you wander through our 40 acres of rolling meadows and beautiful groves

claims.text: The resort is within walking distance of Aspen's outdoor pursuits, skiing, shopping and restaurants.

findings.quote: Aspen Meadows is within walking distance of Aspen’s year-round outdoor pursuits, skiing, shopping, and restaurants

claims.text: All accommodations are suites, inspired by the resort's Bauhaus roots.

findings.quote: All of our accommodations are spacious, newly reimagined suites, inspired by our Bauhaus roots

claims.text: The guest suites feature floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary furnishings.

findings.quote: guest suites feature floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary furnishings

claims.text: Every suite has living, working and sleeping areas, suiting everyone from business travelers to families.

findings.quote: Every suite is thoughtfully designed with living, working, and sleeping areas to accommodate everyone from business travelers to families.

claims.text: The junior suites include Ferenc Berko photographs and a drop station for gear and jackets.

findings.quote: Rooms include a "drop station" for catching gear and jackets, and Ferenc Berko photographs.
Suite includes a "drop station" for catching gear and jackets, and Ferenc Berko photographs.

claims.text: The Health Center has TRX, cardio and weight equipment, a Peloton bike, steam rooms, an outdoor heated saline lap pool, a hot tub and a half-court indoor gym with basketball.

findings.quote: has TRX, cardio and weight equipment, a Peloton bike, steam rooms, an outdoor heated saline lap pool, a hot tub, as well as a half court indoor gymnasium with basketball.

claims.text: The Racquet Sports Center, in partnership with Brisas, has a padel court, a petanque court, backgammon tables and a lounge.

findings.quote: We are proud to partner with Brisas at our Racquet Sports Center.
featuring a padel court, pétanque court, backgammon tables, clothing shack and lounge

claims.text: Guests have a complimentary ski shuttle to Buttermilk.

findings.quote: Guests enjoy our complimentary ski shuttle to Buttermilk.

claims.text: Through a partnership with Ski Butlers, ski rentals are delivered to all four mountains or directly to the resort.

findings.quote: we’ve partnered with Ski Butlers to provide you with an effortless and convenient ski rental experience
Ski Butlers deliver to all four mountains, or directly to Aspen Meadows Resort.

claims.text: The West End Social restaurant has 270-degree views of Aspen's mountains.

findings.quote: Our newly reimagined restaurant features 270-degree views of Aspen’s mountains

claims.text: The entire 40-acre property was designed by Herbert Bayer between 1953 and 1973 and is considered a Bauhaus-inspired total work of art.

findings.quote: Our entire 40-acre property, designed by Herbert Bayer between 1953 and 1973, is considered a Bauhaus-inspired “total work of art.”

claims.text: The campus includes three art galleries and many Bayer-designed outdoor sculptures, including Anaconda, Marble Garden and Kaleidoscreen, along with the earthworks of Anderson Park.

findings.quote: The campus includes three art galleries and many Bayer-designed outdoor sculptures, including Anaconda, 1978, Marble Garden, 1955, and Kaliedoscreen, 1957 along with the iconic earthworks of Anderson Park

claims.text: Bayer's Grass Mound, completed in 1955, is one of the first earthworks ever made, predating the land art movement by nearly ten years.

findings.quote: Herbert Bayer’s Grass Mound was completed in 1955. Notably, this is one of the first earthworks ever made, predating the land art movement by nearly ten years.

claims.text: Andy Goldsworthy's Stone River, a serpentine sandstone wall, winds into and through the campus's Doerr-Hosier Center.

findings.quote: renowned artist Andy Goldsworthy’s sandstone serpentine wall winds into and through the Doerr-Hosier Center

claims.text: Visitors can sign up for complimentary guided walking tours led by landscape architect Ann Mullins.

findings.quote: Visitors can also sign up for complimentary guided walking tours led by landscape architect Ann Mullins.

claims.text: The resort has no elevators.

findings.quote: No elevators

claims.text: A private patio or balcony comes with most guest suites, not all of them.

findings.quote: Private patio or balcony—available in most guest suites

claims.text: The outdoor heated lap pool must be reserved; the hot tub is first-come, first-served.

findings.quote: Our outdoor heated lap pool is available by reservation. The outdoor hot tub is available on a first-come, first-served basis
